tech.viewTitle: Developer: everything. Play as US / USSR: the other side's private information is hidden and the model plays it.
tech.newGameTitle: A new game with a fresh deal; asks for the play mode first
tech.resultTitle: The result, and adding the game to the stats database
tech.showAnalysisTitle: Show the model's readout -- win chances, move probabilities, search -- and its badges on the board. On in the Developer view, off when you play a side.
tech.leaderboardTitle: Elo ratings of the published models

cards.allTitle: All 110 cards and where each one is

analysis.autoplayTitle: This side plays the model's favourite automatically; you play the other

mode.title: How do you want to play?
mode.devText: Both hands, every option, the debug tools and replays. You move both sides, or let the model play one.
mode.usText: The USSR's hand and headline stay hidden; the model plays the USSR. No hints: its win chances and move probabilities stay off unless you turn on Show analysis.
mode.ussrText: The US's hand and headline stay hidden; the model plays the US. No hints: its win chances and move probabilities stay off unless you turn on Show analysis.

model.hfRepoTitle: A public Hugging Face model repo holding .onnx exports (tools/export_onnx.py)
model.fileTitle: An .onnx export (tools/export_onnx.py); you can also drop it anywhere on the page

search.rolloutTitle: Its top moves each played out by the model in sampled worlds, then the best only on a clear lead over the policy's move. By default the search the Hugging Face repo names (the best player on the leaderboard); the search settings below, or search=rollout:k:worlds:horizon:rule:stop:leaf[:keyed][:aligned][:box4][:beliefN] in the address, for another.
search.movesTitle: The candidates: the policy's most probable moves
search.worldsTitle: Sampled worlds each candidate is played out in
search.horizonTitle: Action-round boundaries a playout runs through
search.ruleTitle: The choice: argmax, z<x> (the best only on an x-SE lead over the policy's move) or kl<t>
search.leafTitle: Whose side a leaf is read from
search.chanceTitle: How a world's candidates share chance: one dice stream (shared), each draw tied to its situation (chance=keyed), or keyed with the player fields packed so a USSR side cannot hide the turn (chance=keyed2)
search.alignedTitle: Every candidate's horizon counted from the end of the mover's own action round
search.box4Title: The opponent's headline revealed by Space Race box 4 kept in every world
search.beliefTitle: Worlds dealt from the policy-likelihood belief over the opponent's hand, with this many hands; 0 = uniform redeals
search.raceTitle: Worlds every candidate plays before a challenger trailing the policy's move leaves the race; the other worlds are played by the policy's move and the challengers left. 0 = every candidate on every world

result.title: Game over
result.formIntro: Add this game to the stats database? With your Playdek rating, games like it estimate the models' strength on Playdek's scale.
result.privacy: Stored privately: your login and rating, the game's moves, the model and how it played, and this page's version. Nothing is sent unless you press Add.
result.downloadTitle: The record as the database would get it, as a .json file

log.title: ACTION STREAM
log.vpFilterTitle: Filter log to only show lines affecting VP and 2 context lines before and 2 context lines after

replay.ribbonTitle: Critic: P(US wins) across the game, each position read from the side to move (the only trained reading); the faint dashed line is the other, untrained side's reading. Click to seek.
replay.serverTitle: Replays in the local server's replay directory
